thread:
oliver: Draft of the product launch post for 'Optimize' is up — please quick-review the benchmark language, CTAs, and lead routing. Draft link: https://drive.google.com/xxx
maya: Will review now, aiming for EOD.
sam: Skimming — will check webinar CTA mapping and HubSpot flow.
harry: Noted the hero is a placeholder. Can we get a final 1200x600 export and a version with terminal + dashboard? I can do that today.
oliver: Thanks, Harry. If you can add an image showing latency chart that'd be great.
harry: Uploaded v1 here: https://drive.google.com/harry/v1.png — alt text proposed: "Engineer monitoring inference latency dashboard". Thoughts?
nina: Quick legal note: avoid absolute comparative claims like "cheaper than cloud providers" or "faster than X" unless we can cite the benchmark method. Replace with "reduces per-token inference cost for typical LLM workloads" or back with explicit test details.
oliver: Good call. I'll update the sentence. Proposed replacement: "Reduce per-token inference costs for typical LLM workloads through batching, caching, and quantization-informed serving profiles."
maya: That reads better. Also, we need the webinar CTA routing clear: who owns the registrant funnel and UTM scheme?
sam: I'll own HubSpot mapping. Use UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch. I'll also tag leads with lead_tag=optimize_launch and route to SDR queue when score >=50.
oliver: Added the CTA links with UTM params in the draft. For ops, here's the lead payload snippet to ingest:
```json
{"source":"blog","campaign":"optimize_launch","lead_tags":["blog","optimize_launch"],"utm":{"source":"blog","medium":"post","campaign":"optimize_launch"}}
```
maya: Perfect. Also can we include a short CTO quote? Jamie sent something in email earlier.
jamie-cto: "Optimize lets engineering teams get predictable cost/performance on real workloads — we built it to make inference economics a first-class engineering concern."
oliver: Dropped Jamie's quote in a pullquote under the intro.
harry: Design approvals: hero (A700), CTA button #1 (A700), secondary CTA (B300). Also included mobile crop. :white_check_mark:
nina: Legal quick-pass: reworded the three flagged lines. Approve once the final numbers are footnoted with method link. :white_check_mark:
maya: Copy final pass complete; tightened headline and shortened intro to focus on outcomes for engineers. Updated meta-description for SEO.
sam: Webinar logistics: I'll set up the registration form, automated confirmation email, and HubSpot workflow. ETA by Friday.
oliver: Thanks — planning publish for 2026-03-30 09:00 PT. Can someone do a final pre-publish check 24h before?
maya: I'll run the pre-publish checklist and social copy.
harry: I'll push final assets and image alt text to the CMS.
deploy-bot: publish-scheduler: scheduled post 1716140400 (2026-03-30 09:00 PT).
oliver: Awesome — thanks team. If anyone sees any last-minute copy/claims issues ping me here. :rocket:
